status: Design proposal for Claude integration in GM; owner score pending

tokens.houseBackgrounds: Existing inline HOUSES colours retained unchanged

layout.position: Existing right-hand grid column; align-self:start; intrinsic content height capped by available grid height. Tablet max-height560px.
layout.reason: A compact top-aligned panel leaves the painted background visible and keeps the character canvas in its existing column. No artificial empty lower half on iPad.
layout.createButton: Within panel but outside scroll body, flex:none; 44/48/52 px minimum by breakpoint. Visible without scrolling in every audited case.
layout.overflow: Existing .body can scroll as a fallback for future content; all current audited cases need 0 px scrolling.

selection.agesHairstylesAndSubtabs: Existing .on class: two-pixel gold border plus inset 3–4 px underline; selected card differs in shape as well as colour.
selection.house: Existing .on class: double border, gold outline and dark inset underline; retains house colour.
selection.swatches: Existing crRefresh writes selected border inline as rgb(66, 82, 196). Match that existing style attribute with CSS, add a gold outline and a dark check on gold badge. No new state class or HTML required.
selection.swatchSelectorDependency: Selector [style*="rgb(66, 82, 196)"] relies on the current inline selected-border value. If Claude later changes that value or emits a new state class, update the selector correspondingly.
selection.originalColour: Existing orig ::after return symbol gets an opaque ink disk so it stays readable across the conic colour sample.

integration.scope: Every selector begins #cr.art195.c193. Only .side and its descendants / #cgo are styled. Existing GM art gate supplies art195.
integration.fallback: All frames use solid CSS colours and borders; no 9-slice or image download. Existing Itim with system-ui,sans-serif fallback.
integration.unchanged: HTML structure, left rail, background animation, character canvas geometry, game state and actions.

validation.matrix: 4 viewports × 2 languages × 8 states =64; five main tabs plus adult age, hair-colour and mouth subpanels.
validation.method: Chromium, touch viewport DPR1, local Itim loaded; proposed stylesheet appended in browser only. Real taps switch tabs. Every visible panel button checked for dimensions, pairwise overlap and reachability; text checked for computed font size, overflow and WCAG relative luminance contrast against solid fills or worst opaque gradient endpoint. Full state measurements below.
